title: CI fails on macOS runner: codesign step missing entitlements
description: Pipeline fails on macos-13 runner. codesign complains about missing entitlements plist. Repro on tag v2.8.1.

title: Docs: API auth section still mentions private tokens
description: Our README references Private-Token header; should be Bearer PAT. Also update curl examples for /projects search.

title: Rate limit headers missing on 429 responses
description: When API returns 429, it should include RateLimit-Reset/Remaining. Currently only returns JSON error.

title: Search results ordering feels random for namespace matches
description: Query "acme payments" returns older forks ahead of main repo. Can we boost exact namespace/path matches?

title: Fork fails when upstream default branch was renamed to trunk
description: Fork keeps trying to copy master; new fork ends up without default branch. Seen on repos migrated from GitHub.

title: Binary file upload via create_or_update_file corrupts content
description: Uploading a PNG via API returns 201 but file hash differs after download. Suspect base64 decode path.

title: Improve 404 error for missing file path in get_file_contents
description: Currently returns generic Not Found. Include ref and path in message, similar to GitLab: "File not found".

title: Branch creation should reject names with trailing dot
description: We allow 'release.' which breaks some tooling. Git itself blocks these; align validation with git-check-ref-format.

title: Push files: delete operation should be atomic with updates
description: Mixed ops sometimes apply updates even when delete fails (missing file). Expect all-or-nothing behavior.

title: Add CODEOWNERS support for review assignment
description: Would like to parse .gitlab/CODEOWNERS and auto-suggest reviewers/assignees for MRs touching paths.

title: Webhook deliveries stuck in retry loop after 502
description: After a transient 502, delivery retries forever even after success. Expect stop after 3 consecutive successes.

title: Archived project should still allow reading issues but not creating
description: UI currently shows 'New issue' button for archived repos; API returns 403. Hide button or show reason.

title: Merge request diff view slow on large JSON files
description: Diffing 6–8MB JSON takes 20s+ and sometimes times out. Consider streaming diff or size threshold warning.

title: SSO group sync drops project members unexpectedly
description: After nightly sync, maintainers lose access on some projects. Logs show 'external_id changed'. Need safeguard.

title: Soft-deleted issues still appear in project export
description: Export includes issues where status=deleted. Should exclude by default like other reads.

title: Default branch should be protected on new repository creation
Issue created via API ignores assignee when provided as username
description: POST /issues with assignee_username returns 201 but assignee is null. assignee_user_id works. Need alias support.
